title: Adventure Awaits in Costa Rica: The 2026 Thrill-Seeker's Guide
metaDescription: Push your limits in Costa Rica. From extreme sports to wilderness expeditions, this guide covers the best adventure experiences.
excerpt: For adrenaline junkies and outdoor enthusiasts, Costa Rica is a playground of epic proportions. This guide reveals the most thrilling adventures waiting for you.
author: Travel Editors
content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Costa Rica. Whether you are seeking adventure in Costa Rica for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Extreme Sports

- Skydiving and paragliding over Costa Rica's stunning landscapes
- White-water rafting on raging rivers that cut through Costa Rica
- Rock climbing and bouldering on world-class routes
- Bungee jumping from iconic bridges and platforms

![Adventure in Costa Rica](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1602190630787-ad7cb65afa78?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Wilderness Expeditions

Mountain expeditions in Costa Rica challenge experienced climbers with technical routes and high altitudes.

## Water Adventures

- Scuba diving in crystal-clear waters with vibrant marine life
- Surfing legendary breaks that attract pros from around the world
- Kayaking through dramatic fjords and along rugged coastlines
- Snorkeling over coral reefs teeming with colorful fish
